description: IBL HealthCare Limited markets, sells and distributes healthcare products, and began in 1997 as a wholly owned subsidiary of The Searle Company Limited before converting to a public limited company. It works as a marketing affiliate, building its portfolio in infant formula, adult nutrition and medical disposable products under licensing arrangements with international companies including Mead Johnson Nutrition, Nestlé Health Science, Meditech and Mepaco.
